items.name: Canadian Championship 2019

venue.name: [Scotiabank Convention Centre ](http://www.fallsconventions.com/)
venue.address: 6815 Stanley Ave, Niagara Falls, ON L2G 3Y9
venue.details: The main stages will be Exhibit Hall A, with the side room events taking place in rooms 201 & 202

items.information: The first 250 competitors who register will be guaranteed a free gift pack! The content of the gift packs is a surprise! More gift packs may or may not be given out at the competition. Event change requests will not be accepted with the exception of FMC and only until 11:59 UTC on Saturday July 20th.

items.name: Massachusetts Championship 2019

venue.name: [Boston University](http://www.bu.edu/studentactivities/about-us/)
venue.details: In the big gym on the first floor of the BU Student Activities Office Building

items.information: This is the third competition hosted at Boston University, this time with all 18 WCA events! This is the state championship for Massachusetts, however anyone can attend. See more information on the [Massachusetts State Champion Eligibility Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MassachusettsChampionship2019#10653-champion-eligibility) **Those not competing in FMC do not need to show up on Friday.**
